allow: Shell(bash -c ' echo "=== OS RELEASE ==="; cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null echo "=== KERNEL ==="; uname -a echo "=== DMI / MODEL ==="; cat /sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor /sys/class/dmi/id/product_name /sys/class/dmi/id/product_version 2>/dev/null echo "=== USB DEVICES ==="; lsusb 2>/dev/null || echo "lsusb not present" echo "=== PCI DEVICES ==="; lspci 2>/dev/null || echo "lspci not present" echo "=== FINGERPRINT-LIKE USB ==="; lsusb 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "finger|fpc|synaptics|elan|goodix|validity|upek|authentec|egis|138a|27c6|06cb|147e|08ff|0483|2541" echo "=== FPRINT TOOLING ==="; command -v fprintd-enroll fprintd-list fprintd-verify 2>/dev/null; dpkg -l 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "fprint|libfprint" || echo "no fprint packages" echo "=== FPRINTD SERVICE ==="; systemctl status fprintd 2>/dev/null | head -8 || echo "fprintd not installed" echo "=== PAM ==="; grep -rl "pam_fprintd" /etc/pam.d/ 2>/dev/null || echo "pam_fprintd not configured anywhere" echo "=== BIO CLASS ==="; ls -l /sys/class/fingerprint 2>/dev/null || echo "no /sys/class/fingerprint" echo "=== MODULES ==="; lsmod 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "fprint|upeke2|goodix|elan" || echo "no fingerprint kernel modules loaded" ')

Shell(bash -c ' echo "=== ACPI DEVICES (hid + status + name) ===" for d in /sys/bus/acpi/devices/*/; do hid=$(cat "$d/hid" 2>/dev/null) st=$(cat "$d/status" 2>/dev/null) printf "%-12s %-12s %s\n" "$hid" "$st" "$d" done | sort echo echo "=== FINGERPRINT-ISH ACPI ===" for d in /sys/bus/acpi/devices/*/; do hid=$(cat "$d/hid" 2>/dev/null) case "$hid" in *FPC*|*ELAN*|*GXFP*|*FOCAL*|*FT9*|*SYNA*|*GDIX*|*FLT*|*MELFAS*|*FINGER*|*FP*|*GX*) echo "$hid -> $d";; esac done echo echo "=== I2C DEVICES ===" for d in /sys/bus/i2c/devices/*/; do echo "$d -> $(cat "$d/name" 2>/dev/null)"; done echo echo "=== SPI DEVICES ==="; ls /sys/bus/spi/devices/ 2>/dev/null || echo none echo "=== SERIAL PORTS ==="; ls /dev/ttyS* /dev/ttyG* 2>/dev/null || echo none echo echo "=== PACMAN FPRINT PKGS ==="; pacman -Qs fprint 2>/dev/null; pacman -Q libfprint fprintd 2>/dev/null echo "=== LIBFPRINT DRIVER DIRS ==="; ls -d /usr/lib/libfprint-2/* 2>/dev/null echo "=== TOD DRIVERS ==="; find /usr/lib /usr/share -iname "*tod*" 2>/dev/null | grep -i fprint echo echo "=== SUDO CHECK ==="; sudo -n true 2>&1 && echo "PASSWORDLESS SUDO OK" || echo "sudo needs password or unavailable" echo "=== DMESG ==="; dmesg 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "i2c-hid|i2c_hid|fprint|elan|goodix|focal|ft9|ish|hid-multitouch" | tail -40 || echo "dmesg denied (needs privilege)" ')

Shell(bash -c ' echo "=== BIOS/BOARD ==="; cat /sys/class/dmi/id/bios_version /sys/class/dmi/id/board_name /sys/class/dmi/id/board_vendor /sys/class/dmi/id/product_sku 2>/dev/null echo "=== /sys/bus/acpi/devices count ==="; ls /sys/bus/acpi/devices/ | wc -l echo "=== ISH / Sensor hub ==="; ls -l /sys/bus/pci/devices/0000:00:12.0/ 2>/dev/null | head; find /sys/bus/pci/devices/0000:00:12.0 -name "*ish*" 2>/dev/null echo "=== hid devices ==="; ls /sys/bus/hid/devices/ 2>/dev/null echo "=== kernel drivers for i2c-hid ==="; ls /lib/modules/$(uname -r)/kernel/drivers/hid/ 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "i2c|hid" echo "=== fprintd version ==="; pacman -Qi fprintd 2>/dev/null | grep -E "Version|Name" echo "=== libfprint version ==="; pacman -Qi libfprint 2>/dev/null | grep -E "Version|Name" echo "=== AUR tod hint ==="; pacman -Qs libfprint-tod 2>/dev/null || echo "no libfprint-tod" echo "=== groups / user ==="; id ')

Shell(bash -c ' echo "=== ACPI TABLE FILES ==="; ls -l /sys/firmware/acpi/tables/ 2>/dev/null | head -50 echo echo "=== FTE3600 SPI DEVICE ==="; ls -l /sys/bus/spi/devices/spi-FTE3600:00/ 2>/dev/null echo "modalias: $(cat /sys/bus/spi/devices/spi-FTE3600:00/modalias 2>/dev/null)" echo "bound driver: $(readlink -f /sys/bus/spi/devices/spi-FTE3600:00/driver 2>/dev/null)" echo echo "=== FTE3600 ACPI ==="; ls /sys/bus/acpi/devices/FTE3600:00/ 2>/dev/null echo "uid: $(cat /sys/bus/acpi/devices/FTE3600:00/uid 2>/dev/null)" echo "modalias: $(cat /sys/bus/acpi/devices/FTE3600:00/modalias 2>/dev/null)" echo echo "=== ALL SPI MODALIAS ==="; for d in /sys/bus/spi/devices/*/; do echo "$d -> $(cat $d/modalias 2>/dev/null) [driver: $(basename $(readlink -f $d/driver 2>/dev/null))]"; done echo echo "=== XXXX0000 i2c device ==="; cat /sys/bus/i2c/devices/i2c-XXXX0000:01/name 2>/dev/null; ls /sys/bus/i2c/devices/i2c-XXXX0000:01/ 2>/dev/null | head echo echo "=== LIBFPRINT INSTALLED FILES ==="; pacman -Ql libfprint 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "\.so|drivers|/usr/lib" | head -40 echo echo "=== FPRINTD BINARIES ==="; pacman -Ql fprintd 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "bin/|\.so" | head echo echo "=== strings available? ==="; command -v strings || echo "no strings" echo "=== ACPI DSDT/SSDT fingerprint hints ===" for t in /sys/firmware/acpi/tables/DSDT /sys/firmware/acpi/tables/SSDT*; do [ -r "$t" ] && strings "$t" 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "finger|fpc|ft9|goodix|focal|GXFP|FPT|FP_N|_HID|elan" done | sort -u | head -80 ' 2>&1 | head -200)

Shell(bash -c ' echo "=== AUR HELPERS ==="; command -v paru yay pamac 2>/dev/null || echo "no AUR helper found" echo "=== BUILD TOOLS ==="; for t in git gcc make meson ninja dkms pacman; do printf "%s: %s\n" "$t" "$(command -v $t || echo MISSING)"; done echo "=== KERNEL HEADERS ==="; pacman -Q linux-zen-headers linux-headers dkms 2>/dev/null || echo "headers/dkms not all installed" echo "=== /lib/modules ==="; ls /lib/modules/ echo "=== SPIDEV ==="; ls -l /dev/spidev* 2>/dev/null || echo "no /dev/spidev devices" echo "=== SPI master ==="; ls /sys/class/spi_master/ 2>/dev/null; ls /sys/bus/spi/devices/ 2>/dev/null echo "=== spidev module ==="; modinfo spidev 2>/dev/null | head -5 || echo "spidev module not found" echo "=== fprintd state ==="; systemctl is-enabled fprintd 2>/dev/null; systemctl is-active fprintd 2>/dev/null echo "=== PAM files ==="; ls /etc/pam.d/ | head -40 echo "=== garuda tools ==="; command -v garuda-update garuda-common-settings 2>/dev/null echo "=== internet check ==="; ping -c1 -W2 1.1.1.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "net OK" || echo "net unreachable" ')

Shell(bash -c ' echo "command: $(command -v glib-mkenums || echo MISSING)" ls -l /usr/bin/glib-mkenums 2>/dev/null || echo "no /usr/bin/glib-mkenums" echo "=== glib2 contents (mkenums/genmarshal/compile-resources) ===" pacman -Ql glib2 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "mkenums|genmarshal|compile-resources|glib-compile" || echo "glib2 provides none of these" echo "=== glib2 version ==="; pacman -Q glib2 glib2-devel 2>/dev/null echo "=== who provides glib-mkenums (installed) ==="; pacman -Qo /usr/bin/glib-mkenums 2>&1 | head -3 echo "=== repo search ==="; pacman -Fy >/dev/null 2>&1; pacman -F /usr/bin/glib-mkenums 2>&1 | head -5 echo "=== related pkgs installed ==="; pacman -Q glib2 glib2-devel python-gobject pkgconf 2>/dev/null ')

Shell(cd /home/backlog/fingerprint_laptop && chmod +x scripts/*.sh scripts/lib/common.sh .githooks/pre-commit && \ echo "=== bash -n syntax check ===" && for f in scripts/*.sh scripts/lib/common.sh .githooks/pre-commit; do bash -n "$f" && echo "ok: $f"; done && \ echo "=== shellcheck (if present) ===" && if command -v shellcheck >/dev/null 2>&1; then shellcheck -S warning scripts/*.sh scripts/lib/common.sh .githooks/pre-commit; echo "shellcheck rc=$?"; else echo "shellcheck not installed"; fi)

Shell(bash -c ' echo "=== modules matching focal/spi ==="; lsmod | grep -iE "focal|spi" || echo "none" echo "=== /dev nodes ==="; ls -l /dev/focal_moh_spi /dev/spidev* 2>&1 echo "=== modinfo focal_spi ==="; modinfo focal_spi 2>&1 | head -25 echo "=== spi-FTE3600:00 uevent ==="; cat /sys/bus/spi/devices/spi-FTE3600:00/uevent 2>&1 echo "=== bound driver now ==="; ls -l /sys/bus/spi/devices/spi-FTE3600:00/driver 2>&1 echo "=== dmesg focal ==="; dmesg 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "focal|fte3600|spi" | tail -20 || echo "dmesg restricted" echo "=== journal fprintd ==="; journalctl -u fprintd -b --no-pager 2>&1 | tail -25 || echo "journal restricted" ')
